claim.text: The struck vehicle became a hazard by entering the ego lane.
Perception delay was 0.1944 s, from hazard onset at 2.7213 s to first detection at 2.9157 s, below the 0.3 s perception threshold.
Command delay was 0.0401 s, from first detection at 2.9157 s to AV brake request at 2.9558 s, below the 0.1 s command threshold.
Brake actuation delay was 1.5 s, from CAN brake request at 2.9617 s to pressure reached at 4.4617 s, above the 0.45 s actuation threshold.
Impact occurred at 8.0 s, 5.2787 s after hazard onset at 2.7213 s.
With nominal perception of 0.2 s, nominal command of 0.05 s, and nominal brake tau of 0.35 s, the counterfactual replay reported no contact and a minimum gap of 14.9414 m.
An independent recheck agreed that the other vehicle had no turn signal during the lane change.
Brake actuation was the stage above its profile threshold, and the nominal replay avoids contact, so brake actuation delay is the primary contributing factor.
